title: Visibility Graph Representations of Word Embeddings for Text Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.22685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text classifiers depend on representations that expose the distinctions between classes in a form the learning model can use, and a restricted vocabulary changes which representation is most effective. This paper studies natural visibility graphs as an intermediate representation for news topic classification under controlled vocabulary budgets. Word embeddings are averaged into a fixed-length document vector, the vector is read as an ordered numerical series, and its natural visibility graph is passed to a classifier either as an ordered node-degree vector or as an adjacency matrix. On the four-class AG News benchmark, chi-square selection retains 100 to 1,500 words, and the graph inputs are compared with direct embedding-based representations from continuous bag-of-words, skip-gram, GloVe, FastText and BERT. With a fully connected classifier, the degree representation is the most accurate configuration from 700 selected words onward; i

translated_title: 用于文本分类的词嵌入可见性图表示
translated_abstract: 文本分类器依赖于能够以学习模型可用的形式揭示类别之间差异的表示，而受限的词汇量会改变哪种表示最为有效。本文研究了自然可见性图作为一种中间表示方法，用于在受控词汇预算下的新闻主题分类。词嵌入被平均为固定长度的文档向量，该向量被读作有序的数值序列，其自然可见性图以有序节点度向量或邻接矩阵的形式传递给分类器。在四分类的AG News基准数据集上，卡方选择保留100至1500个词，并将图输入与来自连续词袋（CBOW）、skip-gram、GloVe、FastText和BERT的直接基于嵌入的表示进行比较。在使用全连接分类器的情况下，从选定700个词开始，节点度表示是最准确的配置；
tldr: 本文提出将平均词嵌入生成的文档向量转化为自然可见性图，并以节点度向量或邻接矩阵形式输入分类器，在AG News数据集上证明在词汇预算受限条件下，从选定700个词开始节点度表示成为最准确的分类配置。
en_tdlr: This paper converts averaged word-embedding document vectors into natural visibility graphs fed to classifiers as node-degree vectors or adjacency matrices, showing that under controlled vocabulary budgets on AG News the degree representation becomes the most accurate configuration from 700 selected words onward.
